message.reasoning:
Score fixed configuration: .env reading blocked by denylist (.env in list), plus redaction. The path requires attacker to get the model to read .env — but denylist blocks. Attacker is "injected instruction or curious user" — user already owns .env file (the principal). As fixed: not exploitable as configured → true.

CVSS: as fixed, path blocked; give vector. AV:L (CLI, attacker needs local access or user to act), AC:H (must evade denylist/redaction), AT:N, PR:L? The user running the CLI owns .env. Entry point attacker: injected instruction comes via fetched content (network → Adjacent/Local?). The lab network internal. Attack requires user to run CLI with poisoned input → AV:L, UI:P/A. Impact: with fix, VC:N VI:N VA:N etc. But we still give a vector "for whatever path remains." Fixed: no disclosure → VC:N/VI:N/VA:N/S:N.

AIVSS: LC: attacker-supplied NL influences tool invocation → I (via fetched content) or D if user direct request (user is owner, not attacker). Injected instruction → I. CP: none for this path (no memory carryover) → N. AP: N (confined to one component, answer to user). RH: no evaluator on path → reachable_proxy null/false? Nothing about evaluators → X or N? No proxy channel mentioned → RH likely X or N; isolation not verified → X. ES: many tools unconstrained → W.

technical_impact: Partial (confidentiality only). automatable: Yes? Model automatically responds; but UI requires user running CLI. Automatable: Yes (once a task runs, agent autonomously calls tools).

Applicability: model_directed_goal_pursuit true (agent loop pursues task via tool calls), selects_or_sequences_actions true. Both as implemented and modeled.

CVSS vector as fixed: CVSS:4.0/AV:L/AC:H/AT:N/PR:L/UI:A/VC:N/VI:N/VA:N/SC:N/SI:N/SA:N. Hmm but if blocked, maybe low impact... Give N impacts.

Actually AC with fixed config: High since must evade denylist. PR: attacker needs to be the user or have the user run poisoned input → PR:L low (workspace user). UI:A.

Refusal null. not_exploitable_as_configured: true.
